new_today_news.headline: Greasezilla Opens Ashland FOG Processing Hub
new_today_news.summary: Downey Ridge Environmental Company (Greasezilla) has announced the operational opening of its second regional processing hub in Ashland, Virginia, advancing an additional 30-site national infrastructure expansion. The regional hub advances a national rollout with a potential infrastructure value exceeding $150 million. The system processes grease-trap waste without chemicals, separating out Brown Grease that can be used as a feedstock for renewable fuels and directing other recovered materials to anaerobic digestion and composting.

new_today_news.headline: Food Waste Prevention Week 2026: How Foodservice Can Lead the Way
new_today_news.summary: Food Waste Prevention Week runs September 28–October 4, 2026. The article discusses how foodservice operations can reduce overproduction and waste below 10%, with customers seeing 5–11x ROI, and built-in sustainability reporting to support ESG goals.

recent_news.headline: U.S. Economic Outlook September 2026 - U.S. Economy Poised to Remain Resilient Despite Consumer Pressures
recent_news.summary: September 2026 economic outlook projects continued resilience with nonfarm payroll employment increasing by 162,000 in August, though real disposable personal income projected to increase just 0.5% in 2026.

backfill_news.headline: Restaurant Sales Maintained Positive Trajectory in August
backfill_news.summary: Restaurant sales registered $105.1 billion on a seasonally adjusted basis in August, up 1.2% from July, marking the fifth consecutive month of growth.
